purpose: Test whether the post-hoc Children observation 97254 generalizes prospectively to other related Robert Miles versions, while comparing against unrelated same-catalog controls retrieved through the same Bandcamp public mp3-128 pipeline.
stream_rule: Use only the public mp3-128 URL exposed by Bandcamp trackinfo. Hash exact retrieved bytes. Do not substitute downloads, FLAC, alternate masters, or manually selected encodes.

directional_hypothesis_if_any_structure_.null: Related and unrelated pairs are exchangeable with respect to these SHA-256 metrics apart from ordinary sampling noise.

analysis_plan.pair_level: Report all metrics for every pair without omission.
analysis_plan.group_level: Compare arithmetic means for M1-M3 and counts for M4 between five related and five controls.
analysis_plan.permutation_test: Enumerate all choose(10,5)=252 assignments of the ten frozen pair records into two groups of five and compute one-sided tail probabilities for the preregistered directions. Because some pairs share tracks, label-permutation p-values are descriptive rather than a proof of independent sampling.
analysis_plan.monte_carlo_null: For LCS and fixed-position metrics, additionally simulate at least 100000 independent pairs of uniform random 256-bit digests to estimate null tails.
analysis_plan.children_97254_rule: Do not include the known Children pair in prospective p-values or group means.

audio_similarity_parallel_witness.rule: SHA similarity test != audio similarity test.
audio_similarity_parallel_witness.reason: SHA-256 intentionally destroys perceptual similarity information.

ibm_boundary.reason: No IBM Quantum hardware access is required to test SHA-256 avalanche/null behavior. Any future IBM/Qiskit experiment must be a separately preregistered gate and must not be described as reversing SHA-256.

canonical_seal: FREEZE THE PAIRS AND METRICS BEFORE SEEING NEW DIGESTS. CHILDREN 97254 IS THE CALIBRATION THAT CREATED THE QUESTION, NOT THE ANSWER TO THE PROSPECTIVE TEST.
